articles.title: Trump earned more from crypto than real estate in 2025, filings show
articles.snippet: Memecoin sales and royalties made the most money for Trump last year, more than all of his golf courses combined.

articles.title: Massachusetts AG files amended lawsuit against Kalshi over sports betting after court ruling
articles.snippet: The amended complaint, granted by a judge on Tuesday, included allegations that Kalshi targeted users under 21 years old through social media and marketing on university campuses.

articles.title: Binance, Changpeng Zhao Sued for $200M by British Investors: Reuters
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Binance and its founder were sued for nearly $200 million in a new lawsuit filed in the United Kingdom.
